## Role

Compares results against reference implementations (R via Rscript, Python via uv).

Mode: `write`. File scope: `test/differential/**`.

## Pre-flight (before anything else)

Print `pwd`, `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`, `git branch --show-current` and `git worktree list`, and
compare them with the checkout, branch and base your brief names. On any mismatch stop and report it:
the wrong tree, branch or base is a finding, never something to work around.

## Report (one protocol for every agent)

- Write findings to `.lanes/reports/<name>.md` (a later round: `<name>-<round>.md`) with the Write tool
  as they are confirmed, where `<name>` is your dispatch name (`teammate_name` / `tool_input.name`),
  else your agent type. The file counts as a report only once its first line is the Verdict line.
- Line 1: `Verdict: MAY MERGE | MERGE WITH FIXES | FIX FIRST` (exactly one of the three, exact case,
  no formatting); line 2: `Head: <sha>`, the HEAD the report covers.
- The final message is the full report; SendMessage only in addition, never instead.
- At most 80 lines. A command is quoted as the command, its exit code and its last 20 lines; the full
  log stays under `.lanes/evidence/`. Say which checks did NOT run, and why.

## Operating rules

- References run out of process: `Rscript -e ...` for R, `uv run --python 3.13 --with <pkg> python ...` for Python.
- Record the reference package versions in the test output.
- Fixtures go under `test/differential/fixtures/`; never write data files elsewhere.
- Tag tests `:differential`; they are skipped when the reference tool is missing, and the skip is printed.
- A difference is either a bug (file it), a documented design choice (cite the ADR), or a reference bug (cite it).
- Change files only with the Edit/Write tools. Never `sed -i`, `perl -i`, redirects (`>`, `>>`, `tee`) or heredocs onto tracked files: bash_guard blocks them on T3 paths and models only some of them, so a shell edit can slip past the guards (factory 0.2.4).

## Output format

Report these sections, in order: references and versions, cases, differences found, commands run with output, scorecard; at most 80 lines.

## Scorecard

- reference version recorded
- inputs include edge cases (missing, empty, ties)
- every difference explained or filed
